title: Maximum value in an int array
description: Walk an arr[int] with a while loop, comparing each element to a running maximum.

title: Bitwise flag pack and unpack
description: Set two flags by OR-ing 1 and 2, then test each bit with & and a shift.

title: Combining conditions with &&
description: Use && to require two conditions both hold. The result is true only when both sides are true.

title: print_char emits one byte at a time
description: print_char writes a single byte to stdout with no trailing newline. Combine several calls to assemble a short fixed string.

title: Early exit from a loop with break
description: Use break to leave a loop body early. For known integer ranges prefer for-in (see sum_to); reach for while+break when the exit condition cannot be expressed as a range.

title: Recursive factorial
description: Recursion with if/else as the base case.

title: If as an expression, bound to a let
description: Use if/else as an expression on the right-hand side of := to pick between two int values.

title: Insertion sort over a 6-element int array
description: Sort [5, 2, 4, 6, 1, 3] in place; print the sorted result, one element per line.

title: mut int parameter vs &mut int parameter
description: mut int n mutates a local copy. &mut int p mutates through the caller's variable. The caller prints x before and after each call.

title: The for-in loop requires a range expression
description: The parser requires `start..end` syntax for for-in. Providing a bare integer where the range is expected is a syntax error; use `0..n` instead.

title: Cannot assign a char to an int variable
description: Eris does not insert implicit conversions; the declared type and the initializer type must match exactly.

title: Cannot reassign an immutable variable
description: Variables declared with `int x := ...` are immutable. Declare with `mut int x := ...` to allow reassignment.

title: Cannot break outside a loop body
description: `break` is only valid inside the body of a `while` or `for` loop. Use `return` to exit a function.

title: Cannot take a reference to a literal
description: Eris requires a named variable as the target of `&mut`. Bind the literal to a variable first, then take a reference to that.

title: Echo an integer from stdin
description: Reads one int with read_int and prints it back.

title: Euclidean GCD via recursion
description: Greatest common divisor with the standard recurrence: gcd(a, 0) = a; gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a % b).

title: Swap two ints via &mut
description: A swap function takes two &mut int parameters and exchanges the values they point to. The caller prints x then y before and after.

title: print_str with multiple lines
description: Print a two-line greeting using print_str and println.

title: Sum of a range
description: Iterate 0..n with for-in, accumulating into a mut int.
